description: Call ANY x402-protected HTTPS URL (not just the MPP32 catalog) and pay it from your own wallet: the request is sent, a 402 challenge is parsed (x402 v1 body or v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header), the exact USDC amount is signed on Solana (MPP32_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY) or Base (MPP32_PRIVATE_KEY), and the request is retried once. Refuses to pay above `maxPriceUsd` (default $0.50), MPP32_MAX_PRICE_USD, or your MPP32 session's remaining budget / hourly limit. Returns the response plus on-chain settlement info. Note: this payment goes straight to the provider — it is NOT recorded in the MPP32 dashboard and your MPP32 agent key is never sent to the URL. Prefer `call_mpp32_endpoint` for services in the MPP32 catalog.

body.description: Request body. Objects are sent as JSON; strings are sent verbatim.

headers.description: Extra request headers (payment and MPP32 headers are stripped).

maxPriceUsd.description: Maximum USD you allow this single call to cost. Default 0.5.

url.description: Full https:// URL of the x402-protected resource.

name: pay_x402_url
